title: Tens and Ones: Place Value of 2-Digit Numbers
seo_title: Grade 1 Tens and Ones Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Determine a. the place value of a digit in a 2-digit number, b. the value of a digit, and c. the digit of a number, given its place value; decompose any 2-digit number into tens and ones.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 tens and ones worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: place value, the value of a digit, and breaking 2-digit numbers into tens and ones. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_sub: The value of a digit depends on its place.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A 2-digit number has a tens digit and a ones digit. In 47, 4 is in the tens place and 7 is in the ones place.
  • The value of the 4 in 47 is 40, because it means 4 tens.
  • 47 = 40 + 7 = 4 tens and 7 ones.
  • 10 ones make 1 ten.

Examples

Example

63

6 tens = 60

3 ones = 3

Answer: 60 + 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
4 tens 7 ones as 74Write the tens first: 47.
Value of 3 in 35It is 30, not 3.
Tens or ones?The left digit is the tens.

items.q: Which is another way to make 23?
items.e: Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 10 + 13 = 23. It is still 23.
Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 70 + 14 = 84. It is still 84.

items.q: 34 = 20 + ☐
items.e: Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 3 tens and 4 ones becomes 2 tens and 14 ones. So 34 = 20 + 14.
